span_unit_years.note: First to last measurement date per vehicle, the calendar span between discrete charge tests: Cupra 204 1.3954 years after or before its earlier dates (2022-11-16 to 2022-11-18; here 2024-04-09 to 2024-04-11); Cupra 213 1.3547 years after or before its earlier dates (2022-11-29 to 2022-12-11; here 2024-04-17 to 2024-04-19); Cupra 288 1.3291 years after or before its earlier dates (2022-11-23 to 2022-12-15; here 2024-04-12 to 2024-04-14); Cupra 349 1.4094 years after or before its earlier dates (2022-11-25 to 2022-11-27; here 2024-04-23 to 2024-04-25); Cupra 397 1.4163 years after or before its earlier dates (2022-11-11 to 2022-11-13; here 2024-04-12 to 2024-04-13); Porsche Taycan (AMS) 0.0046 years (2024-06-12 to 2024-06-14); Porsche Taycan (FTM) 0.0040 years (2023-12-01 to 2023-12-02); VW ID.3 (GB, defective cell) 0.0045 years (2024-04-03 to 2024-04-05). Tesla files carry no timestamps and are left out. For the held vehicles only the time outside their dates in bilfinger2024 and bilfinger2026 counts.
